goal: Let a signed-in team track inventory across categories, items, and stock adjustments.

tasks.title: Email/password auth and protected app shell
tasks.acceptanceCheck: Signed-out access to any app route redirects to sign-in; a signed-up user can sign in and reach the app shell.

tasks.title: Category list, create, edit, delete
tasks.acceptanceCheck: A signed-in user creates, edits, and deletes a category; deleting a category with items attached shows an inline error and does not delete it.

tasks.title: Item list with filters, create/edit/delete, bulk quantity edit
tasks.acceptanceCheck: A signed-in user creates an item in a category, filters the list by category and by low-stock, and applies one quantity delta to 2+ selected items in a single bulk action.

tasks.title: Stock adjustment log and per-item history view
tasks.acceptanceCheck: Adjusting an item's quantity, single or bulk, requires a reason and appends one adjustment row per item; the item's history view lists its adjustments most recent first.
